narrative.overview: A songbook you can read in the dark. Videoke night is taken only as palette, type, density and one move: the LED song number. The ground is Stage Indigo, the shell is Mic Magenta, and the number is the product, so every result is led by a seven-segment numeral on a dark tile while the rest of the screen stays calm and complete. Dark is the default because people use it in a dim room; the light theme, Fiesta Blush, keeps the same hues darkened for contrast.
keyCharacteristics: Dark default, light Fiesta Blush alternative, switched by data-theme="light" on the root.
Song numbers in DSEG7 on a tile that is dark in both themes, with unlit "ghost" segments behind the lit digits.
Colour carries meaning: magenta shell, yellow selection, aqua focus, family hue per machine model.
Hyperlegible body face, rounded wordmark face, digit face reserved for numbers.
A "Demo" pill in the header marks the synthetic catalog.

rules.name: The Number Carries Colour Rule
rules.body: Hue is spent on song numbers and the model that owns them. Chrome stays indigo, magenta or neutral.

rules.name: The Contrast Pair Rule
rules.body: Every text and background pair is checked in theme.contrast.test.ts; change a token and its test together.

rules.name: The Digits Only Rule
rules.body: DSEG7 is for song numbers. Never set words in it.

rules.name: The Leading Zero Rule
rules.body: Numbers are strings; render every digit given.

rules.name: The Flat Rows Rule
rules.body: Rows, chips and fields have no shadow at rest or on hover; hover shifts to Surface 2.

dos: Do keep every target at least 48px and every text pair AA.
Do show the model, coverage and source near the results.
Do underline links inside running text.
Do give each machine model family one LED hue and use it consistently across chip, digits and read-out border.
Do keep the LED tile dark in both themes.
donts: Don't use DSEG7 or the LED tile for anything but song numbers.
Don't add shadows to rows, chips or fields.
Don't put gradient text, glass, coloured side stripes, textures or emoji icons on any surface.
Don't use a one-colour accent: selection, focus and shell each have their own hue.
Don't animate layout properties; use opacity and transform, and honour reduced motion.
